source.author: cic
source.text: quae si manet, salvi etiam nunc esse possumus; sin ea crudelitas quae hoc tempore in re publica versata est vestros quoque animos id quod fieri profecto non potest duriores acerbioresque reddit, actum est, iudices; inter feras satius est aetatem degere quam in hac tanta immanitate versari.
source.text_original: quae si manet, salvi etiam nunc esse possumus; sin ea crudelitas quae hoc tempore in re publica versata est vestros quoque animos — id quod fieri profecto non potest — duriores acerbioresque reddit, actum est, iudices; inter feras satius est aetatem degere quam in hac tanta immanitate versari.
source.text_english: If this still remains, we can even now be safe; but if that cruelty which has been at work in the state at this time also makes your minds harder and harsher—a thing which surely cannot happen—then it is all over, judges; among wild beasts it is better to spend one’s life than to live amid such great savagery.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: ecce discedere cupiunt, immo discedunt melius esse dicentes inter feras habitare, quam cum talibus Christianis; et ego ipse, nisi me et corporis imbecillitas et hiemis retineret asperitas, modo fugerem.
reuse.text_original: ecce discedere cupiunt, immo discedunt melius esse dicentes inter feras habitare, quam cum talibus Christianis; et ego ipse, nisi me et corporis imbecillitas et hiemis retineret asperitas, modo fugerem.
reuse.text_english: Behold, they want to depart; indeed, they are departing, saying that it is better to live among wild beasts than with such Christians. And I myself, if my bodily weakness and the harshness of winter did not hold me back, would be fleeing now.
